cost_interpretation.actionable_observation: Warm compressed replay reconstructs the exact same 30 native/24 browser regions with zero new JPP or descriptor bytes; warm GPU replay performs zero decode/upload. Worker time is 73–76ms native and 65–69ms browser, while complete-view settlement is 627–684ms native and ~400ms browser. The dominant measured elapsed boundary is outside worker execution; frame-paced serial dispatch/presentation is a concrete next probe, not an established attribution of all residual time.
cost_interpretation.unavailable: Separate entropy and synthesis wall-time breakdown, physical GPU timing/allocation, scanout and physical storage traffic are not measured. Work counters distinguish transform support from requested output; no claim that legitimate support is a bug.

visual.assessment: PAN4 retained selected aircraft appearance in opened object view. RGB16 low rates show colour ringing/distortion, strongest at 1/2bpp; numerical failure also at4bpp. Browser final captures show correctly shaped full scenes, but U16 full-storage stretch is very dark and not a sufficient real-scene display default. Boca black region corresponds to original nodata. No new blank strip was apparent in opened captures; exhaustive every-view seam/object visual acceptance is not claimed.

limitations: Boca RGB16 source nodata-zero samples change by up to 573 storage codes in fixed views. Original TIFF/metadata are unchanged, but no separate exact nodata mask exists in the lossy indexed representation; exact nodata preservation is not established.
No common quality-passing rate; Boca/Tok application measurements are rejected-configuration diagnostics, not validation of a selected display system.
Independent decoding differs by up to one native code value; byte-exact independent agreement is not claimed.

Recovery retry/reconnect/cancellation/stale evidence passes its individual observations; overall recovery fails mandatory actual eviction because the small catalogue did not exhaust unchanged budgets.
Tok detail latency exceeds frozen native/browser ceilings; no retuning.
No physical network/storage traffic, continuous browser process peak, GPU execution timing or separate entropy/synthesis wall times.
Source coordinates and criterion were frozen before compressed inspection; later object-label clarification did not move coordinates.
Canonical verification and coordinator exact-head review/CI/landing are separate gates.

benchmark_admission.interpretation: Ten successful development runs admitted as calibration-only; two Boca normal journeys qualified against frozen application limits; Tok admitted but unqualified for detail latency; recovery admitted but unqualified for missing actual eviction; five native startup failures retained as failed admissions.
